observation.visible_scene: A horizontal row of eight short, thick candles standing against a pure black background, each a different solid color and each topped by a charred wick with a burning flame. From left to right the bodies are orange, yellow, light blue, magenta-pink, green, pale pink/white, red, and light blue. The wax columns, their heights, and their left-to-right positions stay fixed within the frame throughout; only the flames above them change.
visible_changes: The eight flames continuously flicker: they elongate and shorten, widen and narrow, and lean alternately left and right, so their silhouettes and tip positions differ from frame to frame (e.g., the orange and yellow flames tilt left in some frames and stand more upright or lean right in others).
Flame brightness and shape shift without any flame being extinguished or newly lit; all eight remain burning across the whole excerpt.

The candle bodies and wicks show no positional movement relative to the frame edges, indicating the camera is static and the candles are not translating; the visible motion is confined to flame deformation and swaying, not object displacement.
No wax level change or melting is discernible between the first and last sampled frames at this temporal resolution.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the flame sway (air current or natural convection) is not visible.
Whether the candles were just lit or have been burning for a long time, and any later melting or extinguishing, lies outside this segment.
Any events before t=0 or after the last frame are unknown; the flickering is already ongoing at the first view and continues past the last.
uncertain_details: Subtle independent motion of individual wicks versus motion carried by the flame cannot be cleanly separated.
Tiny frame-to-frame differences in apparent candle height may be focus/blur artifacts rather than real change.
